name: generate_model
description: Generate a 3D model (.glb, PBR textured) on Tripo from a prompt, an image or views (front plus at least one of left, back, right). A task already submitted (a run that stopped or ran out of time names its id) is collected with task-id: no new task, no new charge; never run the step again to get it. Local images are uploaded to Tripo first. WebP or AVIF textures are re-encoded locally so the model loads in Montaj. Standalone.

output.description: Path to the generated .glb. With --json: {path, taskId, model, creditsUsed, textures}.

params.name: prompt
params.description: What to model. Exactly one of --prompt, --image or the views. Required unless --task-id.

params.name: image
params.description: One image of the subject (path or URL; JPEG or PNG).

params.name: view-front
params.description: The front view (path or URL). Multiview needs the front and at least one more.

params.name: out
params.description: Output .glb path. Optional with _project: saved in the project's assets folder.

params.name: face-limit
params.description: Most faces in the mesh: 1,000 to 150,000 (outside that, the nearest end is used).

params.name: negative-prompt
params.description: What to avoid, up to 255 characters. With --prompt only.

params.name: task-id
params.description: Collect a task already submitted (the id a run that stopped or ran out of time names): wait for it and download it. No new task, no new charge; no other input is needed.
